description: This file contains JavaScript functions for UI controls in a WebRTC client, including toggle controls, button and slider event handlers, MAC address validation, Bluetooth device management, modal dialogs, and a command console interface.

methods.name: createToggleControl
methods.description: Creates a toggle switch UI control with callback handling for state changes.

methods.name: createButtonListener
methods.description: Attaches event listeners to buttons identified by ID or class.

methods.name: createSliderListener
methods.description: Binds input and change events to slider elements to trigger a listener.

methods.name: createInputListener
methods.description: Attaches input event listener to a specified input element.

methods.name: createSelectListener
methods.description: Attaches change event listener to a select element.

methods.name: validateMacAddress
methods.description: Validates a MAC address string against a regex pattern.

methods.name: validateMacWrapper
methods.description: Validates MAC address input based on device type and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: parseDevice
methods.description: Parses a device string into ID, name, and MAC address components.

methods.name: btUpdateAdded
methods.description: Updates UI with information about a newly added Bluetooth device.

methods.name: parsePhy
methods.description: Parses a PHY string into ID, name, and devices.

methods.name: btParsePhys
methods.description: Parses Bluetooth PHY information into a dictionary.

methods.name: btUpdateDeviceList
methods.description: Updates the Bluetooth device list UI with current devices.

methods.name: addMouseListeners
methods.description: Adds mousedown, mouseup, and mouseout event listeners to a button.

methods.name: createControlPanelButton
methods.description: Creates a control panel button with icon and event listener.

methods.name: positionModal
methods.description: Positions a modal dialog relative to a button.

methods.name: createModalButton
methods.description: Creates a modal toggle button with drag and show/hide functionality.

methods.name: cmdConsole
methods.description: Initializes a command console interface with input and output handling.
